evaluation_scope.title: ClassVision AI YOLOv8n-pose COCO 2017 Keypoints Independent Verification
evaluation_scope.methodology_label: Official COCO-Style 101-point PR-AUC and Diagnostic Keypoint Metrics

methodology_verification_notes.matching_methodology: Greedy non-replacement matching per image based on maximum OKS >= threshold, sorted globally by detection score.
methodology_verification_notes.false_positive_handling: Detections with no matching GT or duplicate detections on already-matched GT are penalized as False Positives in PR-AUC.
methodology_verification_notes.false_negative_handling: Missed GT instances reduce cumulative recall denominator (total_gt_persons).
methodology_verification_notes.pr_curve_interpolation: Official COCO 101-point recall grid [0.00:0.01:1.00] with right-maximum precision envelope.
methodology_verification_notes.scale_normalization: s = sqrt(gt_area) using annotated segmentation area (or bbox w*h fallback).
methodology_verification_notes.keypoint_sigmas: Official 17 COCO annotator variability sigmas used without modification.
methodology_verification_notes.distinction_note: Evaluated on a 500-image deterministic subset of val2017. Metrics are representative of YOLOv8n-pose performance but not a substitute for the full 5,000-image COCO val2017 or test-dev leaderboard.

classroom_application_and_ethics.keypoint_utility: ClassVision AI uses 17 keypoints (specifically shoulders, elbows, wrists) strictly for geometric arm elevation vs shoulder line.
classroom_application_and_ethics.hand_raising_ground_truth: COCO provides 2D human pose keypoints; it does NOT provide semantic classroom hand-raising ground truth.
classroom_application_and_ethics.occlusion_handling: When upper body keypoints are occluded or below confidence threshold, the posture state enters NEEDS_REVIEW.
classroom_application_and_ethics.privacy_and_biometrics: Zero facial recognition, zero emotion analysis, and zero biometric identity tracking. Faces are blurred via apply_privacy_blur().
classroom_application_and_ethics.volatile_ram_execution: Video and webcam frames remain strictly in volatile RAM and are never persisted to disk.
